reviews.text: I ordered 2lb of cork bark off of Jay's etsy shop end of July and hadn't gotten an update on the shipping for about a month, so I reached out and said he would send out another one and update the tracking number. That was updated and he said it would be here in about 3-5 days, that was 2 weeks ago. The tracking number still said it hadn't been shipped out yet still.... so I asked for a refund today. No response from owner but did give me a refund/cancel my order after reaching out again. This was very frustrating and disappointing, since seeing all the good reviews ( even good reviews on etsy)  before I bought from this shop.
They lie about their jumping spiders being captive bred. Some are actually wild caught. We were lied to about ours.
Nice staff. Can’t wait for the Plant Crawl!
I came in here after finding a Mediterranean house gecko stranded in my room. The employee I spoke to heard my story out and helped me pick out the appropriate fly culture.
Plants are in good shape some do die quickly. A bit expensive and depends on who is working the register. I feel like i get stared at when I visit not very friendly.
Jay's has everything an exotic pet owner needs.

Always a pleasure coming to Jay's. He and his staff are always pleasant to talk to, to the point I spend at least an hour in the store when I'm there.  Jay's always have in stock everything I need to ensure my reptiles are fed and comfortable in their enclosures.
I bought a Halmehara Blue Tongue Skink about 2 months ago and he's been great! Was very healthy and well fed, it was a great experience!
Super friendly, very helpful very informative answer all my question about ball pythons and very patient with me and my boys. If I could give them 10 starts I would!

We’re sorry to see your 1-star review. We always want our customers to have a positive experience, and we’re disappointed that we didn’t meet your expectations. We’d appreciate the opportunity to understand what went wrong and see how we can make things right. Please reach out to us directly so we can help.

Very friendly staff and owner. The animals are well taken care of and all my questions were answered with no hesitation, even adding additional helpful information. I bought a gargoyle gecko and when taken out, looked very healthy and well taken care of. Definitely will be back in the future!
Very beautiful shop, well taken care of reptiles staff was very friendly and knowledgeable would recommend to reptile hobbyist in the philly area this place is amazing thanks for our new addition
FRIENDLY And GREAT HELP

Their feeders are the best, I get their frozen mice for my corn snake and the difference in quality between theirs and the mass produced ones is really noticeable. Their feeders look healthy and clean. The shop itself has good vibes and the animals on display always look good with nice enclosures.

Super nice staffs!!

I brought 2 of my corn snakes who have not been eating for months to this store asking for help. Ive been really concerned about that. The staff here is very nice, telling me a lot and that both snakes are healthy so I don’t need to worry too much, and gave me some suggestions as well. I bought two live pinkies and the result is - both of them did eat!! I’m so grateful and excited.
Ive been here multiple times and will make the drive every time for this store. They've been super helpful everytime.

This past winter, I entered Jay’s because I was in the market for a pet reptile. I got to know Jay’s Exotics manager, Malcolm, who guided me in the process from February—July. Along the way he taught me a lot (i.e. plant needs, bioactive vs naturalistic enclosure advice, handling tips, husbandry suggestions, overcoming discomfort/fears, feeding, plants, + more). I eventually left with a subadult Ball Python that I named after Malcolm. It’s a good store with friendly folks and dope music playing always. Thanks to Jay’s Exotics and Malcolm for the help. I’ll be back for more purchases.
I got my pet scorpion from there and he was very active the staff was also patient and kind 5 out of 5 star staff

best reptile shop in the city, bar none. incredible staff, amazing animals, quality feeders, and quality supplies. also amazing plant section. cannot say enough good things about jay’s.

i moved to philly two years ago and they have been my go to. always super accommodating when i need feeders of a certain size and always going the extra mile with advice. 10/10.
great place clean animals are really healthy and well taken care of

Super great place for plants and exotic lovers. Jay has a lot of variety in products that I don’t see anywhere else in the area and for great prices too! All reptiles are in good enclosures and don’t have me questioning the husbandry. Very very good store!
Came in to look at skinks for my son. Jay was amazing. We went through several different reptiles and care. He was very knowledgeable.
Had a great experience this past weekend. Just moved here not that long ago and Jay was super welcoming! Will absolutely be returning.
No clue how I originally did 3 stars when I KNOW I clicked 5 STARS. Anyway these guys are GREAT! Jay is a great guy and they are very knowledgeable and I highly recommend!

Purchased my male leopard gecko, Blizzard, about two years ago from Jay’s stall at the Baltimore reptile show and he has been the most amazing gecko I’ve ever had. Extremely personable and a healthy appetite from the moment I got him home! …
